easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher, plus an additional 2 life if you cast Timeline Culler using its warp ability.
description:
Cast Timeline Culler from your hand by paying {B}{B} or from your graveyard or hand for its warp cost by paying {B} and 2 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Timeline Culler, adding {B}.
Repeat.
